devices: MacBook Pro built-in microphone and speakers
implementation: AVAudioEngine Voice Processing, mono microphone client format, persistent 16 kHz conversion

speakerComparison.capture: simultaneous raw and processed microphone capture during the same afplay playback
speakerComparison.source: existing official Qwen3 Chinese WAV fixture
speakerComparison.note: Total RMS is diagnostic only because native processing changes gain and noise floor. Earlier all-silent captures and non-speaking trials were excluded from acceptance.

limitations: Simultaneous near speech and speaker playback was requested, but the presence of video playback during the human speech trial was not independently confirmed.
Other microphones, output routes, macOS versions, and long sessions require additional hardware validation.
